TaskDescription: BrainHero interface, online run with real feedback: cued mental tasks. MI: kinesthetic motor imagery of the non-dominant hand; MC (label 'sub'): mental subtraction; LW (label 'word'): generating as many words as possible starting with a given letter.
Instructions: MI (Motor Imagery): Imagine performing a specific movement (e.g.,clenching your fist) while focusing on all the sensations associated with the real movement. You should feel as if you are about to move, but without any actual execution—only the vivid sensation of the intended movement.
InstitutionName: Centre Inria de l université de Bordeaux
